agentGuide: The agent runs in terminal tabs: Cmd+Alt+T opens a new Claude terminal, and its prompt line at the bottom is where you type. A plain shell tab is not the agent.

excludeTests.A3: cmd+alt+t opens a shell tab and Orca types its own claude command into it a moment later, so the first probe letter reaches the shell first (10 Nov, all 10 rows: 'zsh: command not found: dclaude' and 'eclaude', the rest of the probe at the shell prompt). The helper would need to start the probe only once the agent's prompt line is drawn, with t0 still at the action
